lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Friend!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: It's time!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I've finally devised a method

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: where you can hide amongst the Raptures

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: even if you're not familiar with Rapture camouflage.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: You'll just need a little help from me.
You really figured it out?
You never run out of energy.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Giving up isn't in my vocabulary!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: As you know, the Raptocamo is very thick and

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: needs to keep generating repair noises.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: When you made a mistake last time,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: it was difficult for me to point it out in time.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: That won't be a problem with this baby!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Say hello to your new dedicated Hotline for the Raptocamo!
It's called Hotline?
As in a wireless carrier?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: It may not be wireless,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: but its performance is nothing to sneeze at.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Try it out for yourself,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: and you'll see what I mean!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: You can find me at these coordinates.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Try to get here as quickly as possible!
